en: I build data platforms, AI products, and the teams that ship them, so businesses run on data, not slides.
Cut Google Cloud costs by 42.57% in a single quarter while holding SLAs.
Chartered and architected the Gozem Data Hub, serving 650+ people across five African countries.
Built the data team from 0 to 14+ professionals across six countries, reporting at C-level.
Shipped 30+ production AI tools: fraud detection, document intelligence, and RAG customer support.
Held an 88% rider match rate during a 48% demand surge at the Vodun Days festival.
Flagged a 20M+ CFA fraud scheme through the fintech analytics infrastructure he built.
Set governance across 250+ production pipelines with automated quality checks and lineage.
Migrated 10+ TB to Google Cloud within a quarter, with no operational interruption.
Automated invoice extraction, saving each financing manager about 40 hours a month.
A builder-leader hybrid: he led a 14+ person org and kept coding, architecting, and shipping.
Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer and MSc Statistics with Distinction.
2026 author on Data Product Engineering and founding Vice-Chair of iSheero.
